gui.visual-swap.title: Visual Swap
gui.visual-swap.preset.label: Preset
gui.visual-swap.effects.title: Toggles
gui.visual-swap.effects.hint: Hover over a toggle to see what it controls.
gui.visual-swap.effects.mod.label: Mod
gui.visual-swap.effects.mod.help: Enables or disables the entire mod.
gui.visual-swap.effects.hud.label: HUD
gui.visual-swap.effects.hud.help: Toggle all on-screen effects, the crosshair glyph, hotbar highlight, and item flash.
gui.visual-swap.effects.hotbar_highlight: Highlights the hotbar slots in attribute swaps.
gui.visual-swap.effects.item_flash.label: Item Flash
gui.visual-swap.effects.item_flash.help: Makes the selected hotbar item flash using its configured tint.
gui.visual-swap.effects.only_on_swap.hel: When enabled, an item flashes only during attribute swap. When disabled, it flashes whenever the item is click or used as configured.
gui.visual-swap.effects.particles.label: Particles
gui.visual-swap.effects.particles.help: Displays particles when on attribute swapping.
gui.visual-swap.rules.empty: No rules have been added yet. Click the + button above to create one.
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.title: Rule Settings
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.hint: Hover over a setting to see what it controls.
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.strength.hel: How the item is tinted during the flash. Low preserves more of the original shading, while High produces a solid tint.
gui.visual-swap.rule_config.effects.help: Toggle the glyph and hotbar highlight.
gui.visual-swap.preview.title: Matching Items
gui.visual-swap.preview.origin.title: Swap Origin
gui.visual-swap.preview.origin.body:
The hotbar slot you swapped away from,
highlighted using your From colour.
gui.visual-swap.preview.destination.body:
The selected hotbar slot after the swap.
Its item flashes using the active rule's
configured colour and strength.

gui.visual-swap.confirm.discard.title: Discard changes?
